description: This file defines the Aws\S3\Transfer class responsible for transferring files between local filesystem and Amazon S3, supporting upload and download operations with features like multipart upload, concurrency control, and debugging. It implements the PromisorInterface and utilizes Guzzle promises for asynchronous handling.

classes.name: Transfer
classes.description: Handles the transfer of files between local storage and S3, supporting features like multipart uploads, parallel processing, and customizable callbacks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Transfer instance with specified source, destination, client, and options, setting up paths, callbacks, and transfer parameters.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a Promise that resolves when the transfer completes, initiating upload or download depending on source type if not already started.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Synchronously executes the transfer by waiting on the promise.
